title: AzureBicepResourceScopeTests.cs fails to compile against main (stale PR branch, unrelated to PR changes)
error_pattern: error CS0117: 'AzureBicepResourceScope' does not contain a definition for 'ForSubscription' / 'ForTenant'; error CS0619: 'Assert.Throws<T>(Func<Task>)' is obsolete. Test file expects a since-renamed/refactored AzureBicepResourceScope API (CreateForSubscription/CreateForTenant in current src), indicating the PR branch is stale relative to main rather than a defect introduced by the PR's own changed files.
